stemMd: A site area is shown as 12 cm² on a 1:500 plan. What is the corresponding real area?
explanationMd: One drawing centimetre represents five metres, so one square centimetre represents25 square metres. Multiplying12 by25 gives300 m². This is equivalent to applying500² and then converting square centimetres to square metres.

distractorRationale.c: The linear scale factor must be squared for area.
distractorRationale.b: This loses a factor of ten during conversion.
distractorRationale.e: This adds an extra factor of ten.
distractorRationale.a: This applies a linear scaling shortcut to area.
